lines.trans: God, what have you done right now?
I never thought that everything would end right like this.

words.gram: nominative neuter singular, used as a noun

lines.trans: Our life turned out to be too short.

words.gloss: to turn out to be, find oneself

lines.trans: I did not have time to understand simple truths.
If you love a person, tell them about it.
Always thank those who teach you something.
Love your friends and value friendship.
What a pity that I understood all this too late.

words.gloss: it is a pity, too bad

words.gram: nominative neuter singular, used as a noun

lines.trans: But after all, better late than never.
There must be some good option.
Tell us, Kuzma or Dmitry after all?
Alright, let us ask Max right now.

words.gram: imperative, 2nd person singular, imperfective; давай + мы = let's

lines.trans: But after all, better late than never.
There must be some good option.
Tell us, Kuzma or Dmitry after all?
Alright, let us ask Max right now.

words.gram: imperative, 2nd person singular, imperfective; давай + мы = let's

lines.trans: See you soon!

meanings.note: + accusative of the person: благодарить маму

examples.text: Всё, не благодари меня. И с Аникеевым реши.
examples.trans: That's it, don't thank me. And sort out Anikeev.

meanings.note: слава богу = thank God (literally 'glory to God')

examples.text: О, наконец тепло! Слава богу. Сейчас ещё чай сделаю.
examples.trans: Oh, it's warm at last! Thank goodness. Now I'll make some tea too.

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
Present есть; у меня есть = I have.

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.

meanings.note: других вариантов нет = there are no other options

examples.text: Пробуем, других вариантов у нас нет.
examples.trans: Let's try it, we have no other options.

examples.text: Это самый лучший вариант для всех.
examples.trans: This is the very best option for everyone.

examples.text: Трава, говорите? Отлично! Пробуем, других вариантов у нас нет.
examples.trans: Herbs, you say? Excellent! Let's try it, we have no other options.

meanings.note: Adds a reason or an obvious truth.

examples.trans: I did tell you, you know!

examples.text: Садись, не бойся. Я ведь сам чуть тебя не отпустил.
examples.trans: Sit down, don't be afraid. I very nearly let you go myself.
She's offended. She's always like that.

examples.text: Решается ваш вопрос, Клавдия Викторовна! Вы не видите, у меня встреча?
examples.trans: Your question is being sorted out, Klavdia Viktorovna! Can't you see I have a meeting?

meanings.en: after all, still, all the same

examples.text: Аркаш, мне москвичи звонят каждый день. Может, всё-таки передумаем?
examples.trans: Arkasha, the people from Moscow call me every day. Maybe we should reconsider after all?

говорить.gloss: to speak, to say, to talk

meanings.note: Я тебе говорю = I'm telling you.
+ dative of person + accusative of thing
imperative давай/давайте + 1st person plural or infinitive

examples.text: Давай мы его уволим, а тебя на его место назначим.
examples.trans: Let's fire him and put you in his place.

related.gloss: to hand in; to take (an exam)
to reach, walk as far as

meanings.note: + infinitive; agrees with the subject: должна (f)

examples.text: Жадность, Паша, должна быть умеренная. Комнатной температуры.
examples.trans: Greed, Pasha, should be moderate. Room temperature.
This is Vanya, my childhood friend.

examples.text: Это Паша, мой заместитель. Это Ваня, друг моего детства.
examples.trans: This is Pasha, my deputy. This is Vanya, my childhood friend.

examples.text: Конечно, между нами только крепкая искренняя дружба.
examples.trans: Of course, between us there is only strong sincere friendship.

meanings.note: думать о + prepositional = to think about

examples.trans: I have no time to think about that.

examples.text: Мне некогда об этом думать. Слишком много дел.
examples.trans: I have no time to think about that. There's too much to do.

meanings.note: condition: если хочешь = if you want; а если нет? = and if not?

жаль.gloss: it is a pity, too bad

meanings.en: it is a pity, too bad

examples.trans: It is a pity that the project cannot be launched.

examples.text: Жаль, что наш проект нельзя запустить.
examples.trans: It is a shame that our project cannot be launched.

meanings.note: adds emphasis to the word before it

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.

meanings.note: The thing that ends is the subject.
деньги закончились = the money ran out

examples.text: Всё, выборы закончились. Тебя начальник ждёт.
examples.trans: That's it, the election is over. Your boss is waiting for you.

meanings.note: emphasis: вот поэтому ты и... = that's exactly why you...

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: вот именно = that's just it, quite right

examples.text: Именно это я и хотел сказать.
examples.trans: That is justamente what I wanted to say.

examples.text: Вот именно. Но мне сдаваться нельзя.
examples.trans: Exactly. But I must not give up.

examples.text: Я не успел понять простые истины.
examples.trans: I didn't have time to grasp the simple truths.

meanings.note: Как вы знаете = as you know.

examples.trans: Hello! How was it in Hungary?

meanings.note: declines like какой: какая-то, какое-то, какие-то

examples.text: Бред какой-то. Но, с другой стороны, чем я рискую?
examples.trans: What nonsense. But on the other hand, what have I got to lose?

meanings.note: Not long in duration or length.

examples.trans: I simply took a short break.
Fine, write up a short plan for the story.
Arkady Borisovich, who are your rivals?
I love our town very much.
You're in love with another man's wife!

meanings.en: to do (something wrong), make a mess
meanings.note: Что ты натворил? = What have you done?

examples.trans: Look at what they've done here!

examples.text: Что ты натворил? — Марина, он врёт, он симулянт!
examples.trans: What have you done? — Marina, he's lying, he's a faker!

meanings.note: наш, наша, наше, наши; agrees with the noun

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
used with не before the verb, or alone

examples.text: Я никогда не был на море.
examples.trans: I've never been to the sea.

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо ещё.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need more.
I want to, but I can't.

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо сделать ещё больше.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need to do even more.

meanings.note: + prepositional; об before a vowel: об этом

examples.text: Мне некогда об этом думать. Слишком много дел.
examples.trans: I have no time to think about that. There's too much to do.

оказаться.gloss: to turn out to be, find oneself

meanings.en: to turn out to be, prove to be

examples.trans: You turned out to be ungrateful.

examples.text: Он внезапно оказался в центре событий.
examples.trans: He suddenly found himself in the center of events.
And you turned out to be an ungrateful woman!

meanings.note: accusative/genitive его (него after prepositions), dative ему (нему)

meanings.en: other forms: его (gen/acc), ему (dat), им (instr), нём (prep)

meanings.note: пока не поздно = before it's too late

examples.trans: Run, Marina, before it's too late!

examples.text: Беги, Марина, пока не поздно! А ключи можешь мне оставить.
examples.trans: Run, Marina, before it's too late! And you can leave me the keys.

meanings.note: Понял? = got it?; понял = got it.

examples.trans: Share it all equally with everyone, understand?
I know the problems of ordinary people.

meanings.note: refers back to the subject: 'он держит своё слово' = he keeps his word

examples.text: А что я за мэр такой, который держит своё слово?
examples.trans: And what kind of mayor would I be if I kept my word?

examples.text: Конечно, помогу. Кто у вас сейчас начальник?
examples.trans: Of course I'll help. Who's your boss now?

meanings.note: once; что скажешь? = what do you say?

examples.trans: Tell us, when will your programme be out?

examples.text: Мне некогда об этом думать. Слишком много дел.
examples.trans: I have no time to think about that. There's too much to do.

meanings.en: to ask (a question, or someone: спросить у кого-то)

examples.text: А спросите у него, куда он дел компьютерный класс.
examples.trans: Ask him where he put the computer lab.

examples.text: Да? А спросите у него, куда он дел компьютерный класс.
examples.trans: Really? Then ask him where he put the computer lab.

meanings.note: At the start of a question.

examples.trans: So I shouldn't wait for you?
So I shouldn't wait for you tonight?

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

успеть.gloss: to make it, to be in time

meanings.en: to make it, to be in time
meanings.note: + на: успеть на поезд = catch the train

examples.trans: We'll make it! The president speaks for a long time.

meanings.note: Учить уроки = to do one's homework.

examples.trans: Not allowed? All right, I'll go and do my homework.

examples.text: Какое хорошее утро! Лидия Алексеевна, чашку кофе, пожалуйста.
examples.trans: What a lovely morning! Lidia Alekseyevna, a cup of coffee, please.

meanings.en: to value, to appreciate, to esteem

examples.text: Город высоко ценит вас и вашего мужа.
examples.trans: The city values you and your husband highly.

examples.text: Слушай, Лёля, я очень ценю, что ты приехала.
examples.trans: Listen, Lyolya, I really appreciate that you came.

meanings.note: the plural is a different word: люди, людям, о людях

examples.trans: There are a lot of people here.
I know the problems of ordinary people.

meanings.note: in comparisons: больше, чем = more than

examples.text: А почему нет? Продавец получает больше, чем преподаватель.
examples.trans: Why not? A sales assistant earns more than a lecturer.

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

meanings.note: instrumental чем-то: чем-то помочь = help with something

examples.text: Так может быть, тебе надо чем-то помочь?
examples.trans: So maybe you need help with something?

meanings.note: pointing at a thing or a situation; 'это' + noun = 'this is ...'
points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом

examples.trans: And this is for you. A toy car!

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
